name: Hayabusa Kisuke
source:
A man in his 40s who is Miwa's husband and works as a gardener for the Kouno family.

He has been indebted to the Kouno family ever since he was rescued from a debt-ridden situation by the Protagonist's father.

He calls the main character "Bocchan" and has served as his servant. He has almost no male function and is in a state where he has no control over his wife.
